main_text.head: CAPVT II. De Duplici Religionis Iudaicae Principio, Sacra Scriptura, seu Lege scripta, Lege qȯ Orali Talmude comprehensa, totaq; utriusq; ratione.
I.
main_text.p: Tota, universaque Lex, Mosi in Sinai tradita, ex fidei Judaicae articulo octavo, cum Prophetarum reliquorum vaticiniis, ex fidei articulo sexto, discriminata tum in תורה שבכתב Legem scriptam, quinqÿe Mosis libris comprehensam, tum in תורה שבעל פה, Legem Oralem, in Pandectis Talmudicis Babylonicis, Hierosolymitanisque obviam, à Karraeis, Samaritanis, Saddu-caeisque tamen negatam, Indice Maimonide articulo fidei nono: Lex Mosis Magistri nostri C super

page.notes: Hebrew words in the text are reproduced approximately; the Hebrew phrases "כל התורה" at the start and "תורה שבכתב", "תורה שבעל פה" are printed inline. The final line is partly cut by a catchword-like mark "C" and "super" at the foot; "C" may be a signature fragment. Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably in "Talmudicis" and "Maimonide".
